metadata.title: Moradi Gallery · Immersive watch experience
metadata.description: A visual engineering case study for Moradi Gallery: a bilingual luxury watch experience built around WebGL, 3D storytelling and precise motion.

hero.title: Watchmaking told through space and motion.
hero.intro: A bilingual luxury-gallery concept where an original watch moves from hero object to an explorable mechanical story, without losing a fast server-rendered foundation.

live.title: Experience the gallery in motion.
live.description: The live product is the best way to see the WebGL camera travel, staged watch assembly and responsive storytelling together.

screenshot.alt: Persian Moradi Gallery homepage featuring an original black and gold watch

product.title: A visual storefront with an engineering spine.
product.description: The experience balances cinematic art direction with the practical boundaries a real catalog, localization system and accessible fallback need.

features.title: Bilingual by design
features.text: Persian RTL and English LTR routes share one structured content and navigation system.

features.title: Continuous 3D story
features.text: One persistent scene connects camera movement, editorial copy and the watch’s mechanical narrative.

features.title: Staged assembly
features.text: Separately modeled watch parts, material finishes and keyframes reveal the object layer by layer.

features.title: Adaptive experience
features.text: Quality tiers, reduced-motion behavior and a static fallback keep the concept usable across devices.

engineering.title: A motion stack with clear ownership.
engineering.description: GSAP owns scroll choreography, React Three Fiber renders the persistent scene, and Motion stays focused on isolated interface transitions.

notes.title: Server shell, client scene
notes.text: The localized page remains server-rendered while the WebGL experience loads behind a controlled client boundary.

notes.title: Ref-driven choreography
notes.text: Normalized GSAP progress feeds camera and object transforms without per-frame React state updates.

notes.title: Designed to degrade well
notes.text: Reduced motion, device quality tiers and error fallback preserve the story when full 3D is unavailable.
